name: Grave Soil Pouch
summary: A pouch of dark earth that raises the dead for a time.
description: Dug from beneath a barrow that has been empty for a thousand years. The soil is always wet.

stats.effect: As a Magic action, you can scatter this soil on a corpse that has been dead no longer than 1 day. The creature returns to life with 1 hit point, but has the {ref:condition/charmed} condition and obeys your spoken commands for 24 hours, after which it dies again. The soil is consumed.
